<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

## Motivation

<!-- Describe the purpose and goals of this pull request. -->
Fused DSA prefill can produce top-k indices into the batch’s flattened logical KV space. The draft model captures these indices as MTP seeds and reuses them in the next draft decode, which expects physical KV slots.
This mismatch can select incorrect KV entries or cause out-of-bounds reads, particularly when long requests share cached prefixes and logical offsets exceed physical cache capacity.

The engine config that exercises this error:
```
SGLANG_DSA_FUSE_TOPK=1 \
python3 -m sglang.launch_server \
  --model-path /models/PhalaCloud/GLM-5.3-W4AFP8 \
  --quantization w4afp8 \
  --tp 8 \
  --mem-fraction-static 0.75 \
  --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 \
  --dsa-prefill-backend flashmla_sparse_q8 \
  --speculative-algorithm EAGLE \
  --speculative-num-steps 3 \
  --speculative-eagle-topk 1 \
  --speculative-num-draft-tokens 4
```

## Modifications

<!-- Detail the changes made in this pull request. -->

- Add `prepare_mtp_seed_indices()` to map fused RAGGED seeds through the producer’s page table before capture.

## Accuracy Tests

<!-- If this pull request affects model outputs (e.g., changes to the kernel or model forward code), provide accuracy test results. -->
CPU: tests added in `test/registered/unit/layers/attention/test_index_topk_share.py`

## Speed Tests and Profiling

<!-- If this pull request impacts inference speed, provide benchmarking and profiling results. -->
The conversion applies only to fused RAGGED seed export at the draft-prefill (EXTEND) → next draft-decode (DECODE) boundary. Post-verification draft extend (DRAFT_EXTEND_V2) already exports PAGED seeds and requires no conversion.

@Fridge003 @ispobock could you take a look when you have time?

We hit this in production with this PR applied as a hotfix, and it does **not** fully fix the issue.

Setup: GLM-5.3-W4AFP8, TP8 / DP4 dp-attention, EAGLE 3/1/4, fp8 KV, `flashmla_sparse_q8` prefill, fused top-k (default). The engine still crashed with `Triton Error [CUDA]: an illegal memory access was encountered` in EAGLE verify (`eagle_prepare_for_verify` -> `dsa_backend._apply_cuda_graph_metadata` -> `fused_dsa_target_verify_metadata`). This happened right after the KV router sent a burst of ~10 requests sharing a ~220k-token cached prefix to one DP rank.

The gap: this PR converts seeds only on the MHA path (`forward_mha.py`). MHA is used only when `kv_len <= SGLANG_DSA_PREFILL_DENSE_ATTN_KV_LEN_THRESHOLD` (2048 by default). Longer prefills go through MLA sparse, and there the draft model exports seeds through `IndexTopKShareState.publish()` in `index_topk_share.py`. That method still copies the RAGGED (batch-global logical) indices into `dsa_seed_topk_capture` unchanged. So the long-context case this PR describes (logical offsets exceeding physical KV capacity) is still not covered. I think `prepare_mtp_seed_indices()` needs to be applied in the `seed_buf` branch of `publish()` as well.

(Code paths read from our deployed image, sglang-runtime 1.5.0. We have not reproduced it on main yet.)

~~Workaround we are running now: `SGLANG_DSA_FUSE_TOPK=0`. With it, seeds stay request-local and draft decode maps them through the page table.~~ (does not work, see update below)

---

**Update (2026-10-09):**

1. **`SGLANG_DSA_FUSE_TOPK=0` is not a valid workaround.** With it, the engine crashed about 2 min after startup on the first long prefill. The error was `RuntimeError: The size of tensor a (742) must match the size of tensor b (741)` at `dsa_backend.py` `forward_extend` (`topk_indices + topk_indices_offset`) during `_draft_extend_for_prefill`. On the unfused RAGGED path, `topk_indices` is padded to the q row count by `_pad_topk_indices`, but `topk_indices_offset` is not padded. This is a separate bug from the one this PR fixes.

2. **The latest commit (6ad90aae, `write_mtp_seed` on the sparse-MLA `publish()` path) works for us.** We backported the three files onto our sglang-runtime 1.5.0 image (applied cleanly) and ran a burst test: 10 concurrent requests sharing a ~220k-token cached prefix, 3 rounds. Results:
   - 30/30 requests OK, no engine restart, no IMA.
   - The engine logs show prefill batches with `#new-seq: 4, #cached-token: 882432`, so the batch's logical `sum(seq_lens)` (~890k) exceeds the per-rank KV pool (756,544 tokens). That is the condition that crashed the engine before this commit.
   - EAGLE accept length is unchanged (~2.8).

Minor review notes:
- `write_mtp_seed` falls back silently when the resolved backend has no `prepare_mtp_seed_indices`. If a wrapper backend is ever returned there, the old bug would come back without any signal. An assert, or a one-time warning, for the fused + EXTEND case would make that visible.
- A GPU regression test covering many long shared-prefix requests in one extend batch (`sum(seq_lens)` > pool size) would lock this in.

/rerun-test test/registered/unit/layers/attention/test_index_topk_share.py

Targeted validation for 6ad90aae3303. This CPU coverage does not replace the GPU seed-to-draft integration regression requested in review.

> Both the MHA export and IndexTopKShareState.publish now use the seed conversion, and the CPU mapping tests cover the intended representation change. Could we add one GPU regression that exercises the real prefill-to-first-draft-decode transition with SGLANG_DSA_FUSE_TOPK=1 and a shared cached prefix, where ragged logical offsets differ from physical KV slots? Please cover both the MHA and sparse-MLA seed export paths and compare attention outputs or logprobs with a reference. The current tests mock backend selection and the index producer, so they do not yet validate that producer/consumer handoff.

@BBuf thanks for reviewing, i just added a GPU regression test, which covers the handoff from draft prefill to the first draft decode end to end on real kernels. With `SGLANG_DSA_FUSE_TOPK=1` and an fp8 KV cache, it runs the real indexer and fused top-k, the seed export on both paths (dense MHA and sparse MLA, with the backend's own routing choosing between them), and the `flashmla_kv` decode. Requests share cached-prefix pages scattered across the pool, so the ragged logical offsets exceed the KV pool, which is the shape of the production crash. The test checks that every seed index stays inside the pool before any kernel reads it, that the seed exactly matches the physical slots from an independent offset-to-slot mapping, and that decode attention matches an fp32 torch reference.

Both the MHA export and IndexTopKShareState.publish now use the seed conversion, and the CPU mapping tests cover the intended representation change. Could we add one GPU regression that exercises the real prefill-to-first-draft-decode transition with SGLANG_DSA_FUSE_TOPK=1 and a shared cached prefix, where ragged logical offsets differ from physical KV slots? Please cover both the MHA and sparse-MLA seed export paths and compare attention outputs or logprobs with a reference. The current tests mock backend selection and the index producer, so they do not yet validate that producer/consumer handoff.

@@ -927,6 +927,39 @@ def _get_fused_topk_page_table(self, topk_indices: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor
             f"Unsupported {self.dsa_topk_backend = } for SGLANG_DSA_FUSE_TOPK."
         )
 
+    def prepare_mtp_seed_indices(
+        self, topk_indices: torch.Tensor, forward_mode: ForwardMode
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Export a seed in the representation consumed by the next draft decode."""
+        if (
+            not self.use_fused_topk
+            or self.get_topk_transform_method(forward_mode)
+            != TopkTransformMethod.RAGGED
+        ):
+            # PAGED output is already physical; unfused/PD seeds stay request-local.
+            return topk_indices
+
+        # Prefill addresses concatenated logical KV, but fused draft decode
+        # consumes allocator-local physical slots. Leave prefill's input intact.
+        metadata = self.forward_metadata
+        page_table = metadata.page_table_1_flattened
+        if page_table is None:
+            # Without a cached prefix attention does not need a flattened table.
+            # Build it in the producer indexer's request order for seed export.
+            page_table = torch.cat(
+                [
+                    metadata.page_table_1[i, :length]
+                    for i, length in enumerate(metadata.indexer_seq_lens_cpu.tolist())
+                ]
+            )
+        padding = topk_indices == -1
+        # index_select rejects invalid indices. Replace only the padding sentinel
+        # for the gather, then restore it; never clamp a bad positive index.
+        physical_indices = page_table.index_select(
+            0, topk_indices.masked_fill(padding, 0).reshape(-1).long()
+        ).view_as(topk_indices)
+        return physical_indices.masked_fill(padding, -1)
+

+) -> None:
+    """Copy the selected top-k rows into the MTP seed buffer.
+
+    Both the MHA and sparse-MLA prefill paths export seeds here so the backend
+    can convert prefill-only index representations (e.g. fused RAGGED logical
+    offsets) into what the next draft decode consumes.
+    """
+    from sglang.srt.models.deepseek_common.attention_forward_methods.forward_mha import (
+        resolve_attn_backend,
+    )
+

+        resolve_attn_backend(forward_batch), "prepare_mtp_seed_indices", None
+    )

+"""The first draft decode must read the KV slots its draft prefill selected,
+including when shared cached-prefix offsets exceed the KV pool (fused top-k, fp8 KV)."""
+
+import math
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.dsa.dequant_k_cache import dequantize_k_cache_paged
+from sglang.srt.configs.model_config import AttentionArch
+from sglang.srt.environ import envs
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.dsa.dsa_indexer import Indexer
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.dsa_backend import DeepseekSparseAttnBackend
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.index_topk_share import IndexTopKShareState
+from sglang.srt.layers.linear import LinearBase
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.kv_cache_configurator import calculate_mla_kv_cache_dim
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.memory_pool import DSATokenToKVPool
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_batch_info import ForwardBatch, ForwardMode
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_context import ForwardContext, forward_context
+from sglang.srt.models.deepseek_common.attention_forward_methods.forward_mha import (
+    forward_dsa_indexer_for_mha,
+)
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_parallel
+from sglang.srt.server_args import ServerArgs, set_global_server_args_for_scheduler
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=120, stage="base-b-kernel-unit", runner_config="1-gpu-large")
+
+PAGE_SIZE = 64
+INDEX_TOPK = 2048
+NUM_HEADS = 128
+KV_LORA_RANK = 512
+QK_ROPE_HEAD_DIM = 64
+POOL_SIZE = 8192  # slots; the pool allocates one extra page
+CONTEXT_LEN = 8192
+MAX_BS = 8
+HIDDEN_SIZE = 1024
+Q_LORA_RANK = 1536
+
+
+class _Runner:
+    """The model-runner surface DeepseekSparseAttnBackend reads at init."""
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.device = "cuda"
+        self.dtype = torch.bfloat16
+        self.kv_cache_dtype = torch.float8_e4m3fn
+        self.is_draft_worker = False
+        self.is_hybrid_swa = False
+        self.sliding_window_size = None
+        self.page_size = PAGE_SIZE
+        self.max_running_requests = MAX_BS
+        self.hisparse_coordinator = None
+        hf_config = SimpleNamespace(
+            architectures=["DeepseekV3ForCausalLM"],
+            index_topk=INDEX_TOPK,
+            index_head_dim=128,
+            index_n_heads=32,
+        )
+        self.model_config = SimpleNamespace(
+            context_len=CONTEXT_LEN,
+            is_multimodal=False,
+            attention_arch=AttentionArch.MLA,
+            num_attention_heads=NUM_HEADS,
+            kv_lora_rank=KV_LORA_RANK,
+            qk_rope_head_dim=QK_ROPE_HEAD_DIM,
+            qk_nope_head_dim=128,
+            hf_config=hf_config,
+        )
+        self.req_to_token_pool = SimpleNamespace(
+            size=MAX_BS,
+            req_to_token=torch.zeros(
+                MAX_BS, CONTEXT_LEN, dtype=torch.int32, device=self.device
+            ),
+        )
+        # Production sizing: the scaled fp8 layout makes dsa_kv_cache_store_fp8
+        # true, which is what routes fp8 prefill top-k through RAGGED.
+        self.token_to_kv_pool = DSATokenToKVPool(
+            size=POOL_SIZE,
+            page_size=PAGE_SIZE,
+            dtype=self.kv_cache_dtype,
+            kv_lora_rank=KV_LORA_RANK,
+            qk_rope_head_dim=QK_ROPE_HEAD_DIM,
+            layer_num=1,
+            device=self.device,
+            index_head_dim=128,
+            enable_memory_saver=False,
+            kv_cache_dim=calculate_mla_kv_cache_dim(
+                model_config=self.model_config, kv_cache_dtype=self.kv_cache_dtype
+            ),
+        )
+        self.server_args = SimpleNamespace(
+            kv_cache_dtype="fp8_e4m3",
+            speculative_eagle_topk=None,
+            speculative_num_draft_tokens=0,
+            enable_deterministic_inference=False,
+            dsa_prefill_backend="flashmla_sparse_q8",
+            dsa_decode_backend="flashmla_kv",
+            dsa_topk_backend="sgl-kernel",
+            dsa_paged_mqa_logits_backend="auto",
+            disaggregation_mode="null",
+            enable_two_batch_overlap=False,
+        )
+
+
+@unittest.skipIf(
+    not torch.cuda.is_available() or torch.cuda.get_device_capability()[0] != 9,
+    "flashmla_sparse_q8 prefill is SM90-only",
+)
+class TestDSAMTPSeedHandoff(CustomTestCase):
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        server_args = ServerArgs(model_path="dummy")
+        server_args.kv_cache_dtype = "fp8_e4m3"
+        server_args.dsa_prefill_backend = "flashmla_sparse_q8"
+        server_args.dsa_decode_backend = "flashmla_kv"
+        set_global_server_args_for_scheduler(server_args)
+        cls._parallel = get_parallel().override(attn_tp_size=1)
+        cls._parallel.__enter__()
+        cls._envs = [
+            envs.SGLANG_DSA_FUSE_TOPK.override(True),
+            # The server sets this to index_topk; the backend is built directly.
+            envs.SGLANG_DSA_PREFILL_DENSE_ATTN_KV_LEN_THRESHOLD.override(INDEX_TOPK),
+        ]
+        for env in cls._envs:
+            env.__enter__()
+
+    @classmethod
+    def tearDownClass(cls):
+        for env in reversed(getattr(cls, "_envs", [])):
+            env.__exit__(None, None, None)
+        if hasattr(cls, "_parallel"):
+            cls._parallel.__exit__(None, None, None)
+
+    def setUp(self):
+        torch.manual_seed(20261011)
+        self.runner = _Runner()
+        self.backend = DeepseekSparseAttnBackend(self.runner)
+        self.assertTrue(self.backend.use_fused_topk)
+        self.assertTrue(self.backend.dsa_kv_cache_store_fp8)
+        self.pool = self.runner.token_to_kv_pool
+        self.req_to_token = self.runner.req_to_token_pool.req_to_token
+        self.indexer = self._make_indexer()
+        self.layer = SimpleNamespace(
+            layer_id=0,
+            tp_q_head_num=NUM_HEADS,
+            head_dim=KV_LORA_RANK + QK_ROPE_HEAD_DIM,
+            v_head_dim=KV_LORA_RANK,
+            scaling=1.0 / math.sqrt(KV_LORA_RANK + QK_ROPE_HEAD_DIM),
+            is_cross_attention=False,
+        )
+
+    def _make_indexer(self) -> Indexer:
+        hf = self.runner.model_config.hf_config
+        prev_dtype = torch.get_default_dtype()
+        torch.set_default_dtype(torch.bfloat16)
+        try:
+            with torch.device("cuda"):
+                indexer = Indexer(
+                    hidden_size=HIDDEN_SIZE,
+                    index_n_heads=hf.index_n_heads,
+                    index_head_dim=hf.index_head_dim,
+                    rope_head_dim=QK_ROPE_HEAD_DIM,
+                    index_topk=INDEX_TOPK,
+                    q_lora_rank=Q_LORA_RANK,
+                    max_position_embeddings=163840,
+                    rope_theta=10000.0,
+                    layer_id=0,
+                    scale_fmt="ue8m0",
+                    block_size=128,
+                    quant_config=None,
+                )
+        finally:
+            torch.set_default_dtype(prev_dtype)
+        # weights_proj keeps fp32 params as in production.
+        for name, module in indexer.named_modules():
+            if isinstance(module, LinearBase) and "weights_proj" not in name:
+                module.to(dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+        return indexer.cuda()
+
+    def _layout(self, prefix_len: int, suffix_lens: list[int]):
+        """Scatter pages; requests share the prefix pages like a radix hit.
+
+        Row b of req_to_token covers prefix + suffix + one decode slot. Row
+        len(suffix_lens) owns only the prefix and is used to warm it.
+        """
+        num_pages = POOL_SIZE // PAGE_SIZE
+        pages = (torch.randperm(num_pages) + 1).tolist()  # page 0 is padding
+        prefix_pages, pages = (
+            pages[: prefix_len // PAGE_SIZE],
+            pages[prefix_len // PAGE_SIZE :],
+        )
+        rows = []
+        for suffix_len in suffix_lens:
+            own = math.ceil((suffix_len + 1) / PAGE_SIZE)
+            row_pages, pages = prefix_pages + pages[:own], pages[own:]
+            rows.append(row_pages)
+        rows.append(prefix_pages)
+        for b, row_pages in enumerate(rows):
+            slots = torch.tensor(row_pages).repeat_interleave(
+                PAGE_SIZE
+            ) * PAGE_SIZE + torch.arange(PAGE_SIZE).repeat(len(row_pages))
+            self.req_to_token[b, : slots.numel()] = slots.to(torch.int32).cuda()
+        used = torch.unique(self.req_to_token[: len(rows)].flatten())
+        used = used[used > 0]
+        # Random latent KV for every slot a request can reach.
+        self.pool.set_mla_kv_buffer(
+            self.layer,
+            used.long(),
+            torch.randn(
+                used.numel(), 1, KV_LORA_RANK, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16
+            ),
+            torch.randn(
+                used.numel(), 1, QK_ROPE_HEAD_DIM, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16
+            ),
+        )
+
+    def _extend_batch(self, rows, prefix_lens, extend_lens, spec_info=None):
+        seq_lens = [p + e for p, e in zip(prefix_lens, extend_lens)]
+        out_cache_loc = torch.cat(
+            [
+                self.req_to_token[r, p : p + e]
+                for r, p, e in zip(rows, prefix_lens, extend_lens)
+            ]
+        ).long()
+        positions = torch.cat(
+            [
+                torch.arange(p, p + e, device="cuda")
+                for p, e in zip(prefix_lens, extend_lens)
+            ]
+        )
+        num_tokens = sum(extend_lens)
+        batch = ForwardBatch(
+            forward_mode=ForwardMode.EXTEND,
+            batch_size=len(rows),
+            input_ids=torch.zeros(num_tokens, dtype=torch.long, device="cuda"),
+            req_pool_indices=torch.tensor(rows, device="cuda"),
+            seq_lens=torch.tensor(seq_lens, device="cuda"),
+            seq_lens_cpu=torch.tensor(seq_lens),
+            out_cache_loc=out_cache_loc,
+            seq_lens_sum=sum(seq_lens),
+            positions=positions,
+            extend_num_tokens=num_tokens,
+            extend_prefix_lens=torch.tensor(prefix_lens, device="cuda"),
+            extend_prefix_lens_cpu=prefix_lens,
+            extend_seq_lens=torch.tensor(extend_lens, device="cuda"),
+            extend_seq_lens_cpu=extend_lens,
+            spec_info=spec_info,
+        )
+        hidden = torch.randn(
+            num_tokens, HIDDEN_SIZE, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16
+        )
+        q_lora = torch.randn(
+            num_tokens, Q_LORA_RANK, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16
+        )
+        return batch, hidden, q_lora
+
+    def _run_indexer(self, batch, hidden, q_lora):
+        return self.indexer(
+            x=hidden,
+            q_lora=q_lora,
+            positions=batch.positions,
+            forward_batch=batch,
+            layer_id=0,
+        )
+
+    def _export_seed(self, path, prefix_len, suffix_lens):
+        """Warm the shared prefix, then run the draft prefill export."""
+        bs = len(suffix_lens)
+        with forward_context(ForwardContext(attn_backend=self.backend)):
+            warm, warm_hidden, warm_q = self._extend_batch([bs], [0], [prefix_len])
+            self.backend.init_forward_metadata(warm)
+            self._run_indexer(warm, warm_hidden, warm_q)
+
+            spec_info = SimpleNamespace(
+                dsa_topk_indices=None,
+                dsa_seed_topk_capture=torch.full(
+                    (bs, INDEX_TOPK), -2, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda"
+                ),
+                dsa_seed_topk_select=(
+                    torch.cumsum(torch.tensor(suffix_lens, device="cuda"), 0) - 1
+                ).long(),
+            )
+            batch, hidden, q_lora = self._extend_batch(
+                list(range(bs)), [prefix_len] * bs, suffix_lens, spec_info
+            )
+            self.backend.init_forward_metadata(batch)
+            self.assertEqual(self.backend.use_mha, path == "mha")
+
+            produced = []
+            indexer = self.indexer
+
+            def recording_indexer(**kwargs):
+                out = indexer(**kwargs)
+                produced.append(out)
+                return out
+
+            if path == "mha":
+                forward_dsa_indexer_for_mha(
+                    recording_indexer,
+                    hidden_states=hidden,
+                    q_lora=q_lora,
+                    positions=batch.positions,
+                    forward_batch=batch,
+                    layer_id=0,
+                )
+            else:
+                # The sequence deepseek_nextn runs on the sparse-MLA path.
+                state = IndexTopKShareState.from_mtp_carry(batch)
+                state.update(
+                    recording_indexer(
+                        x=hidden,
+                        q_lora=q_lora,
+                        positions=batch.positions,
+                        forward_batch=batch,
+                        layer_id=0,
+                    )
+                )
+                state.publish()
+        (logical,) = produced
+        logical = logical[spec_info.dsa_seed_topk_select]
+        return spec_info.dsa_seed_topk_capture.clone(), logical
+
+    def _expected_slots(self, logical, prefix_len, suffix_lens):
+        """Oracle: RAGGED offset -> (request, local position) -> physical slot."""
+        kv_lens = [prefix_len + s for s in suffix_lens]
+        starts = [0]
+        for kv_len in kv_lens[:-1]:
+            starts.append(starts[-1] + kv_len)
+        expected = torch.full_like(logical, -1)
+        for b, (start, kv_len) in enumerate(zip(starts, kv_lens)):
+            row = logical[b]
+            valid = row != -1
+            local = row[valid].long() - start
+            self.assertTrue(bool(((local >= 0) & (local < kv_len)).all()))
+            expected[b, valid] = self.req_to_token[b, local]
+        return expected
+
+    def _decode(self, seed, prefix_len, suffix_lens):
+        """First draft decode carrying the seed through mtp_iteration."""
+        bs = len(suffix_lens)
+        seq_lens = [prefix_len + s + 1 for s in suffix_lens]
+        decode = ForwardBatch(
+            forward_mode=ForwardMode.DECODE,
+            batch_size=bs,
+            input_ids=torch.zeros(bs, dtype=torch.long, device="cuda"),
+            req_pool_indices=torch.arange(bs, device="cuda"),
+            seq_lens=torch.tensor(seq_lens, device="cuda"),
+            seq_lens_cpu=torch.tensor(seq_lens),
+            out_cache_loc=torch.stack(
+                [self.req_to_token[b, n - 1] for b, n in enumerate(seq_lens)]
+            ).long(),
+            seq_lens_sum=sum(seq_lens),
+            positions=torch.tensor([n - 1 for n in seq_lens], device="cuda"),
+            spec_info=SimpleNamespace(
+                dsa_topk_indices=seed,
+                dsa_seed_topk_capture=None,
+                dsa_seed_topk_select=None,
+            ),
+        )
+        q = torch.randn(
+            bs,
+            NUM_HEADS,
+            KV_LORA_RANK + QK_ROPE_HEAD_DIM,
+            device="cuda",
+            dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+        )
+        with forward_context(ForwardContext(attn_backend=self.backend)):
+            with IndexTopKShareState.mtp_iteration(
+                decode, keep_carry_seed=True
+            ) as state:
+                carried = state.topk_indices
+                self.backend.init_forward_metadata(decode)
+                out = self.backend.forward_decode(
+                    q,
+                    None,
+                    None,
+                    self.layer,
+                    decode,
+                    save_kv_cache=False,
+                    topk_indices=carried,
+                )
+        return q, out.view(bs, NUM_HEADS, KV_LORA_RANK)
+
+    def _reference_attention(self, q, expected):
+        kv_buffer = self.pool.get_key_buffer(0)
+        outs = []
+        for b in range(q.shape[0]):
+            slots = expected[b][expected[b] >= 0]
+            kv = dequantize_k_cache_paged(kv_buffer, slots.int()).view(
+                slots.numel(), -1
+            )
+            scores = (q[b].float() @ kv.float().T) * self.layer.scaling
+            outs.append(torch.softmax(scores, dim=-1) @ kv[:, :KV_LORA_RANK].float())
+        return torch.stack(outs)
+
+    def _check_handoff(self, path, prefix_len, suffix_lens):
+        self._layout(prefix_len, suffix_lens)
+        seed, logical = self._export_seed(path, prefix_len, suffix_lens)
+        pool_slots = self.pool.size + self.pool.page_size
+        # The case must put RAGGED offsets past the pool, as in the prod crash.
+        self.assertGreaterEqual(int(logical.max()), pool_slots)
+        # Checked before any kernel reads the seed, so a regression fails here
+        # rather than as an illegal memory access.
+        in_pool = (seed == -1) | ((seed >= 0) & (seed < pool_slots))
+        self.assertTrue(
+            bool(in_pool.all()),
+            f"seed max {int(seed.max())} is outside the {pool_slots}-slot KV pool",
+        )
+        expected = self._expected_slots(logical, prefix_len, suffix_lens)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(seed, expected, rtol=0, atol=0)
+
+        q, out = self._decode(seed, prefix_len, suffix_lens)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(
+            out.float(), self._reference_attention(q, expected), rtol=2e-2, atol=2e-2
+        )
+
+        # Negative control: without the conversion the seed is the raw RAGGED
+        # offsets, which this test must reject.
+        self.req_to_token.zero_()
+        self._layout(prefix_len, suffix_lens)
+        with patch.object(
+            self.backend, "prepare_mtp_seed_indices", lambda indices, mode: indices
+        ):
+            raw_seed, _ = self._export_seed(path, prefix_len, suffix_lens)
+        self.assertGreaterEqual(int(raw_seed.max()), pool_slots)
+
+    def test_mha_export(self):
+        # max kv_len <= index_topk routes the draft prefill through dense MHA.
+        self._check_handoff(
+            "mha", prefix_len=1792, suffix_lens=[200, 150, 250, 180, 220]
+        )
+
+    def test_sparse_mla_export(self):
+        # Longer prefills take sparse MLA and export through publish().
+        self._check_handoff("sparse_mla", prefix_len=5120, suffix_lens=[900, 700, 800])
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main(verbosity=3)

+def _capture(
+    indices, *, fused=True, ragged=True, flattened=True, select=None, path="mha"
+):
+    # Two requests share their first two physical slots. Logical index 5 is
+    # outside the four-slot physical pool, but maps to the valid physical slot 2.
+    table = torch.tensor([[3, 1, 0], [3, 1, 2]], dtype=torch.int32)
+    metadata = SimpleNamespace(
+        page_table_1=table,
+        page_table_1_flattened=table.flatten() if flattened else None,
+        indexer_seq_lens_cpu=torch.tensor([3, 3]),

issue_comments.body:
@Fridge003 @ispobock could you take a look when you have time?

We hit this in production with this PR applied as a hotfix, and it does **not** fully fix the issue.

Setup: GLM-5.3-W4AFP8, TP8 / DP4 dp-attention, EAGLE 3/1/4, fp8 KV, `flashmla_sparse_q8` prefill, fused top-k (default). The engine still crashed with `Triton Error [CUDA]: an illegal memory access was encountered` in EAGLE verify (`eagle_prepare_for_verify` -> `dsa_backend._apply_cuda_graph_metadata` -> `fused_dsa_target_verify_metadata`). This happened right after the KV router sent a burst of ~10 requests sharing a ~220k-token cached prefix to one DP rank.

The gap: this PR converts seeds only on the MHA path (`forward_mha.py`). MHA is used only when `kv_len <= SGLANG_DSA_PREFILL_DENSE_ATTN_KV_LEN_THRESHOLD` (2048 by default). Longer prefills go through MLA sparse, and there the draft model exports seeds through `IndexTopKShareState.publish()` in `index_topk_share.py`. That method still copies the RAGGED (batch-global logical) indices into `dsa_seed_topk_capture` unchanged. So the long-context case this PR describes (logical offsets exceeding physical KV capacity) is still not covered. I think `prepare_mtp_seed_indices()` needs to be applied in the `seed_buf` branch of `publish()` as well.

(Code paths read from our deployed image, sglang-runtime 1.5.0. We have not reproduced it on main yet.)

~~Workaround we are running now: `SGLANG_DSA_FUSE_TOPK=0`. With it, seeds stay request-local and draft decode maps them through the page table.~~ (does not work, see update below)

---

**Update (2026-10-09):**

1. **`SGLANG_DSA_FUSE_TOPK=0` is not a valid workaround.** With it, the engine crashed about 2 min after startup on the first long prefill. The error was `RuntimeError: The size of tensor a (742) must match the size of tensor b (741)` at `dsa_backend.py` `forward_extend` (`topk_indices + topk_indices_offset`) during `_draft_extend_for_prefill`. On the unfused RAGGED path, `topk_indices` is padded to the q row count by `_pad_topk_indices`, but `topk_indices_offset` is not padded. This is a separate bug from the one this PR fixes.

2. **The latest commit (6ad90aae, `write_mtp_seed` on the sparse-MLA `publish()` path) works for us.** We backported the three files onto our sglang-runtime 1.5.0 image (applied cleanly) and ran a burst test: 10 concurrent requests sharing a ~220k-token cached prefix, 3 rounds. Results:
   - 30/30 requests OK, no engine restart, no IMA.
   - The engine logs show prefill batches with `#new-seq: 4, #cached-token: 882432`, so the batch's logical `sum(seq_lens)` (~890k) exceeds the per-rank KV pool (756,544 tokens). That is the condition that crashed the engine before this commit.
   - EAGLE accept length is unchanged (~2.8).

Minor review notes:
- `write_mtp_seed` falls back silently when the resolved backend has no `prepare_mtp_seed_indices`. If a wrapper backend is ever returned there, the old bug would come back without any signal. An assert, or a one-time warning, for the fused + EXTEND case would make that visible.
- A GPU regression test covering many long shared-prefix requests in one extend batch (`sum(seq_lens)` > pool size) would lock this in.

Targeted validation for 6ad90aae3303. This CPU coverage does not replace the GPU seed-to-draft integration regression requested in review.

> Both the MHA export and IndexTopKShareState.publish now use the seed conversion, and the CPU mapping tests cover the intended representation change. Could we add one GPU regression that exercises the real prefill-to-first-draft-decode transition with SGLANG_DSA_FUSE_TOPK=1 and a shared cached prefix, where ragged logical offsets differ from physical KV slots? Please cover both the MHA and sparse-MLA seed export paths and compare attention outputs or logprobs with a reference. The current tests mock backend selection and the index producer, so they do not yet validate that producer/consumer handoff.

@BBuf thanks for reviewing, i just added a GPU regression test, which covers the handoff from draft prefill to the first draft decode end to end on real kernels. With `SGLANG_DSA_FUSE_TOPK=1` and an fp8 KV cache, it runs the real indexer and fused top-k, the seed export on both paths (dense MHA and sparse MLA, with the backend's own routing choosing between them), and the `flashmla_kv` decode. Requests share cached-prefix pages scattered across the pool, so the ragged logical offsets exceed the KV pool, which is the shape of the production crash. The test checks that every seed index stays inside the pool before any kernel reads it, that the seed exactly matches the physical slots from an independent offset-to-slot mapping, and that decode attention matches an fp32 torch reference.
